ingredients.name: Squalane
ingredients.description: Squalane is an emollient in the formulation meaning it makes your skin soft, smooth, and lovely. Lip Benefits: Helps prevent dryness and chapping by locking in moisture.

ingredients.name: Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil
ingredients.description: Grapeseed Oil is an emollient and antioxidant meaning it helps your skin to combat collagen-damaging free radicals.

ingredients.name: Argania Spinosa Kernal Oil
ingredients.description: Argan Oil is an antioxidant and emollient. Lip Benefits: Rich in fatty acids and vitamin e, it deeply hydrates dry, chapped lips.

ingredients.name: Hippophae Rhamnoides (Sea Buckthorn) Oil
ingredients.description: Sea Buckthorn Oil is an antioxidant and an emollient. Lip Benefits: Packed with omega fatty acids.

ingredients.name: Brassica Napus Seed Oil
ingredients.description: Rapeseed Oil is an emollient. We wanted to incorperate an emollient into our lip serum that is super sensitive.

ingredients.name: Cera alba
ingredients.description: Beeswax *ethically sourced* is an emollient and thickening agent helping the formulation appear thicker.

ingredients.name: Wildflower Honey
ingredients.description: Wildflower honey is a soothing and moisturizing agent as well as an amazing humectant.

ingredients.name: Tocopherol
ingredients.description: Vitamin E is an antioxidant. We wanted to add a super antioxidant to our formula.

ingredients.name: Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Extract
ingredients.description: Rosemary extract is an antioxidant and is used in this formulation as an extra preservative.

ingredients.name: Dimethicone
ingredients.description: Dimethicone is an emollient. Lip Benefits: Forms a lightweight protective barrier on the lips.

ingredients.name: Centella Asiatica
ingredients.description: Centella Asiatica is an antioxidant and is known as a soothing ingredient.
